stableToolContracts.overwriteBehavior: writing tools retain documented safe overwrite behavior

stableIdentifierContracts: existing normative Markdown front-matter ids must not be reused or changed incompatibly
existing schema $id values must remain compatible within their versioned contract
existing tool result field names and meanings must remain compatible
existing C# package front-matter ids and direct skill name csharp are stable
baselineExclusionRule: Every standards package not explicitly listed in stablePackages remains outside the 1.0.0 stable package promise for this release candidate, even when its paths remain repository compatibility surfaces.

requiredActions: Update the recorded repository source from v0.10.0 to the reviewed 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate when deliberately evaluating the release candidate.
Re-run repository or project validation after changing the pinned standards source.
Treat only languages/csharp as a stable package commitment; do not infer stable maturity for baseline packages.
reviewActions: C# adopters should review the newly explicit stable compatibility commitment.
PowerShell adopters using Windows PowerShell 5.1 should review the additive legacy compatibility overlay.
Mixed-profile adopters using --include-profile-required should review the additive secondary-profile discipline expansion.
preservedContracts: repository governance and exception authority after the v0.10.0 policy transition

final100GateNotYetClaimed: at least one 1.0.0-rc.N must be published and available for review before final 1.0.0
release artifacts and checksums for the final candidate must be independently verified
final 1.0.0 compatibility approval requires independent specialist review on the exact final release commit
